title: Multiple and random DASH Pod BT disconnect (pump unreachable)
symptom: Starting in Dev-L on May 30th, the phone intermittently loses Bluetooth connection to the DASH Pod, resulting in 'pump unreachable' notifications. The issue became daily, with timeouts occurring during communication attempts, and the pump could not reconnect until the phone was restarted.
fix: The issue resolved itself after about 7 days without any specific action; the user closed the issue noting no disconnects in the past 7 days.
evidence_quote: Past 7 days, no disconnects so not sure what was going on. will close the issue.
